messages:
maya: Heads-up — quick design review: API key creation modal for org admins. WIP mock attached. Need copy, accessibility, and perms gating feedback.

jeremy: Sketch looks good. Two immediate concerns: 1) wording around 'permanent' keys, 2) keyboard/tab flow when toggling 'restrict to routes' — focus should land on the first route input.

olga: Strong +1 on avoiding the word 'permanent'. Suggest: 'No expiry (recommended only for service accounts)'. Also prefer a TTL dropdown (1h, 1d, 7d, 30d, no expiry) instead of radios for density.

sam: Accessibility nit: the red danger banner contrast is ~3.8:1 on the mock — we need >=4.5:1 for body text. Also ensure the CTA in danger area has a visible focus outline in high-contrast themes.

aisha: UX for previewing the key: show a one-time masked string like '••••••••••••••••' with a small inline 'Show' button. When shown, announce via aria-live: 'API key revealed — copy now, this will not be shown again.' Copy action should show transient tooltip 'Copied' and set focus back to the 'Show' button.

jeremy: Audit language: we should add a small line: 'This action will be logged to your org audit trail.' Where to put it? inline under the primary CTA or as a footer note in the modal?

maya: Let's put the audit line directly under the Create button as subdued text with a link to audit settings. Visible but low-emphasis.

product-bot: Figma updated: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd123/admin-key-modal?node-id=42:1 (updated 2h ago) :spiral_calendar_pad:

olga: Rotation flow for CI/shared keys: add optional 'Notify team' checkbox that auto-generates a templated message and copies rotation script. We should also offer pre-built scripts for common CI systems.

sam: Draft rotation script (to include in template):
```bash
# rotate current key -> new key
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/rotate" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer OLD_KEY' \n  -d '{"notify":true, "project":"webapp"}'
```
Use this to prefill the message for teams.

aisha: Revoke confirmation: debating 'type DELETE to confirm' vs a single-step modal with checkbox. For discoverability and accessibility, prefer a simple confirm input but we can make the phrase configurable per org risk level.

jeremy: Also: scope controls — org owners should see a granular scope dropdown (read: embeddings, generate, admin), while project members should see a simpler 'project-scoped' toggle. We need to ensure the UI communicates effective permissions clearly.

maya: Keyboard-only flow note: 'Show key' must be reachable via Enter/Space on the eye button. Once revealed, focus should move to the copy button. Screen reader should get a live region message about one-time visibility.

olga: Small copy nits: replace 'Revoke immediately' with 'Revoke now — this cannot be undone.' Make the CTA consistent: primary action verbs should be sentence case and short.

jeremy: Color tokens: I'll spec the danger background and text tokens and add a11y checks to the QA checklist.

maya: Action items: maya — update Figma/copy, jeremy — spec contrast tokens + QA checks, sam — add rotation script variants + copy, olga — draft team notification template, aisha — write accessible live region copy and keyboard flow steps.

maya: I'll push a new mock before tomorrow's sync. Meeting: 10am tomorrow to finalize. :+1:
